verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a single community report that a team used Asana itself for remote team communication instead of Slack or Basecamp. No first-party documentation describes in-app chat, messaging, or comment threads. The Slack and Microsoft Teams integrations route conversation through external chat apps, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: first-party docs on native chat/messaging or comment threads inside Asana, details on real-time conversation features, and broader independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in

citations.quote: my team always used it for remote team communication and project management. We never saw the need for apps like Slack or Basecamp
